# Dataset List

Contact details: support\@ecocommons.org.au

# About this list

This is the **full, layer-level list** of every record in the EcoCommons production catalogue — all **58,424** of them. Use the search box to filter across every column, and click a column header to sort.

::: callout-note
Remember that **records are not products**: one WorldClim variable, for a single model, scenario and month, is its own row, so this list is ~90% WorldClim future-climate layers. For the "what products do we have" view, see the [Data Catalogue](prod_dataset_catalogue.qmd); for how it was extracted, see the [audit](ecocommons_prod_data_audit.qmd).
:::

The table below loads from [`dataset_list.csv`](data/dataset_list.csv) (also available to [download](data/dataset_list.csv)). The `uuid`, `data_subcategories` and `created` fields are omitted here for readability — they are in the full extract (`prod_dataset_list_full.csv`), regenerated on demand by `extract_prod_datasets.py`.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("data/dataset_list.csv").csv({ typed: true })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof query = Inputs.search(data, {
  placeholder: "Search titles, collections, categories, resolutions…",
  width: "100%"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
md`**${query.length.toLocaleString()}** of **${data.length.toLocaleString()}** records shown.`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(query, {
  rows: 18,
  sort: "Title",
  columns: [
    "Title", "Category", "Time domain", "Year", "Resolution",
    "Spatial domain", "Data type", "Collection", "Downloadable"
  ],
  format: {
    Year: x => (x == null || x === "") ? "" : String(x)
  },
  width: {
    "Title": 320,
    "Category": 85,
    "Time domain": 90,
    "Year": 50,
    "Resolution": 115,
    "Spatial domain": 100,
    "Data type": 90,
    "Collection": 185,
    "Downloadable": 95
  }
})
```
